IRONSPINE_FEAT_DESCRIPTION.English:
Hauling heavy loads over long distances has hardened your back.

Unlock by carrying a total of 10,000 kg·km: kilograms carried times kilometers walked.

IRONSPINE_Threshold_Desc.English:
Kilograms carried times kilometers walked needed to unlock Iron Spine.
Default: 10,000

IRONSPINE_BonusKg_Desc.English:
Extra carry capacity while Iron Spine is enabled.
Default: 3 kg
